key_insight: This study builds the first large spin-polarized electronic-structure database for stable halide double perovskites, revealing a rich pool of visible-gap and half-metallic candidates.
engineering_relevance: The dataset accelerates materials screening for photovoltaics, photocatalysis, and radiation detection by linking composition, band structure, magnetism, and bonding in one searchable resource.
method: Hybrid-functional DFT DOS calculations for >2,500 Cs2BB'X6 compounds (X = I, Br, Cl, F)
Stability screening based on the τ tolerance factor of Bartel et al.
LOBSTER bonding analysis plus UMAP visualizations and an interactive exploration app
evidence_signal: The abstract reports more than 2,500 compounds, including 719 visible-band-gap materials and 118 half-metals, all supported by computed DOS and bonding descriptors.
watch_item: Results are computational and stability-filtered, so experimental validation is still needed before selecting specific candidates for device integration.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
